0022600127.text: The Warriors (0-3, on a three-game losing streak) are 15th in the West and 5th in the Pacific, 2.5 games back, and this is their fourth game of the season, a road trip to the Denver Nuggets (1-1, on a one-game win streak, 1-0 at home, 8th in the West). Golden State is missing Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee surgery), and Brandon Williams (back soreness), Charles Bassey (knee), and Gui Santos (knee tendinitis) are day-to-day with game-time decisions, while Denver is without Julian Strawther (knee sprain) and Spencer Jones (hamstring), with Alpha Diallo (wrist) and Cameron Johnson (ankle sprain) also day-to-day. The 2026-27 season series has no games yet, after the teams split 2-2 in 2025-26, and the Warriors lost 116-93 in Denver in their last meeting on March 29, 2026.
